passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: There are six people in my family.
We live together in one home in Seoul.
phrases.ko: 우리는 서울의 한 집에서 함께 살아요.

phrases.en: We eat dinner together almost every day.
phrases.ko: 우리는 거의 매일 함께 저녁을 먹어요.

phrases.en: We talk and we laugh at the table.
My family is happy, and I love my family.
phrases.ko: 나의 가족은 행복하고, 나는 가족을 사랑해요.

phrases.en: There is my father, my mother, and my brother.
There is also my older sister and my little sister.
I am thirteen, and my little sister is eleven.
phrases.ko: 나는 열세 살이고, 여동생은 열한 살이에요.

phrases.en: Six people make our home warm and loud.
phrases.ko: 여섯 사람이 있어서 우리 집은 따뜻하고 시끌벅적해요.

phrases.en: I am happy because we are together.

full_passage_spoken: There are six people in my family. We live together in one home in Seoul. We eat dinner together almost every day. We talk and we laugh at the table. My family is happy, and I love my family. My family loves me too. There is my father, my mother, and my brother. There is also my older sister and my little sister. I am thirteen, and my little sister is eleven. Six people make our home warm and loud. I am happy because we are together.
